books.title: Llewellyn's Complete Book of Meditation: A Comprehensive Guide to Effective Techniques for Calming Your Mind and Spirit
books.author: Shai Tubali
books.description: Shai Tubali's guide to thirty-five meditation techniques from traditions around the world, from Zazen and Dzogchen to Sufi whirling, dhikr and Ramana Maharshi's self-inquiry, plus one method of his own. Each comes with its history, cultural setting and clear instructions for practising at home.

flags: ISBN from https://www.llewellyn.com/product.php?ean=9780738772066 (ISBN-13 9780738772066 converted to ISBN-10 0738772062), not confirmed elsewhere. Llewellyn names Shai Tubali PhD as sole author (January 2023).

Health: the publisher's blurb says meditation brings reduced stress, decreased pain, improved sleep and fewer age-related memory problems; wellbeing benefits of practice, no claim to cure or treat a disease, so kept under the 12 Nov rule.
